title: Angular version contract: every UI component on Angular 22
goal: docs/SOLUTION.md records that NERV web/src, Grover apps/client and FPVBuddy target the same Angular major (22), and FPVBuddy's upgrade from 21 is proposed to its backlog
acceptance: Version compatibility in docs/SOLUTION.md names each UI project's Angular major, read from its package.json on main
A gap proposal for fpvbuddy (Angular 21 to 22) is written for the owner; the coordinator does not upgrade FPVBuddy
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: read three package.json files, one table row and one gap proposal. Not a measurement.
